_comment: Catalog of genre schema packs a story bible can install. Applying a pack ADDS entity kinds and columns and creates a NEW VIEW — it never widens the default Essentials view, so installing one cannot overwhelm a short story. Packs are matched on packKey, so an upgrade improves hints and adds options without disturbing a rename or the author's data. Adding a pack is a PR against this directory: no rebuild, no App Store cycle. That is the point — a LitRPG author must not wait weeks for a stat column. DECODER SAFETY: comment keys at this TOP LEVEL ONLY.

packs.summary: Stats that change across chapters, factions, items with rule text, skills, floors. Numeric columns route to the fact ledger so 'what were their stats in chapter 47' is answerable.
packs.suggestWhen: The manuscript mentions levels, stats, a System, floors, or a status box in more than a couple of chapters.

_plannedPacks.why: suspects, alibis, clues, and a knows/mustNotKnow discipline the fact ledger already supports
